preview2.png.visual_observation: Independently viewed: white iOS welcome screen with Merhaba, Turkish swipe-up instruction, battery icon, information button and home indicator.

fb.png.visual_observation: Root agent viewed a blank/fade phase with battery/information/home indicators; animation-phase interpretation is supported by the earlier welcome screenshot and advancing swap counter.

framebuffer_swap_counter.preview2_provenance: Integration agent recorded QMP/HMP memory read during preview2 capture; not present in preview-registers.txt, which belongs to an earlier preview.
framebuffer_swap_counter.interpretation: Frame swaps continued between the samples; this does not measure physical panel refresh rate or prove complete GUI functionality.

limits: The machine uses Cortex-A78AE surrogates, synthetic contiguous RAM, a development PL011 console and QEMU PSCI; it is not identical to the handset.
XNU retains SWEET/iPhone identities and a RAM framebuffer, with reference phone input/USB probes disabled. Moto UFS, panel, touchscreen, PMIC, radios and secure firmware are unimplemented.
No visible CRASH or panic marker in three retained circular log buffers proves only their absence in those buffers, not continuous crash-free operation or future stability.
The final framebuffer is an animation/fade phase; positive welcome-screen evidence is the independently inspected earlier preview2 capture.
No touch, swipe interaction, setup completion, stock application usability or physical Moto boot was tested in this capture.
